title: Repair Schedule Parts Tier by Ride Option — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The parts tier multiplier of a Wayfare repair schedule estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report is read from the reported trip's ride option: Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV take the luxury parts multiplier; Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL take the premium parts multiplier; any other ride option takes a multiplier of one.

| Ride option on the trip record | Parts tier | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV | luxury | 1.45 |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare XL | premium | 1.2 |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard or Wayfare Green | — | 1 |

The ride option is read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

**What the multiplier applies to.** The multiplier applies to the parts allowance, and the parts tax of the estimate is figured on the parts allowance so multiplied.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** An exterior parts allowance of $152.00 on a Wayfare Black trip: $152.00 multiplied by 1.45 is $220.40, and a parts tax rate taken for illustration as 7.25% is added to $220.40, giving $236.379 before the estimate's final rounding.
